title: Sturdy
text: Sturdy. Looking at the picture, I thought there were more hangers included in this set. I ordered this on my phone and didn't read the whole thing that says there are 6 hangers. The picture shows twice that many. That's my fault for not fully reading it. The hangers are sturdy. I love that they're thin. It really does take up less space in the closet.
